english.title: Owner/master of ship not complying with requirements for navigational systems and equipment and voyage data recorder
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[owner]_
(B)_[master]_

of a ship, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME OF SHIP..), which did not comply with

(C)_[paragraph 1]_
(D)_[paragraph 2]_
(E)_[paragraph 3]_
(F)_[paragraph 7]_

of regulation 18 of Chapter V in the Annex to the International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea 1974 relating to approval, surveys and performance standards of navigational systems and equipment and voyage data recorder in that **(..SPECIFY NON-COMPLIANCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 5(2)(g), 9(1)(b) and (5) of the Merchant Shipping (Safety of Navigation) Regulations 2020.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being the owner / master of a ship
to which the Merchant Shipping (Safety of Navigation) Regulations 2020 applied
proceed / attempt to proceed on
a voyage / excursion
without complying with requirements in
paragraph 1 to 3 AND 7
of regulation 18 of Chapter V in the Annex
to the International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea 1974
in so far as required

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
